skills.name: reach_search
skills.description: Search platforms (reddit, youtube, github, bilibili, v2ex, xueqiu, twitter, boss) via Agent Reach.

channel.description: Platform channel (e.g. reddit, youtube, github, bilibili, v2ex, xueqiu, twitter, boss)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

skills.name: reach_read
skills.description: Read content, discussions, or articles from any URL across 15+ platforms (Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, etc.) via Agent Reach.

url.description: Full URL to read (e.g. reddit post, github issue, youtube video, tweet)

backend.description: Optional backend override (e.g. opencli, jina, exa, gh)

skills.name: reach_transcript
skills.description: Extract speech-to-text transcript or subtitles from a YouTube video, Bilibili video, or Xiaoyuzhou podcast link via Agent Reach.

skills.name: reach_status
skills.description: Check the health, available channels, and operational status of Agent Reach.
